conf.description: Cribl Stream internal-metrics via REST pull (/system/metrics + /api/v1/health): same envelope as the CriblMetrics event feed for the metric branch, folded together with a separate low-cardinality health-object branch keyed on its own shape.

conf.comment: internal-metrics/api-pull: REST Collector response carries the same _metric/_value/_metric_type + dimensions envelope as CriblMetrics events, PLUS a distinct /api/v1/health object (status/startTime, no _metric). Branch each step on presence of _metric so the health object is never forced through the metric grammar.

functions.description: Rollup applies only to the metric branch; the health object has no time-series cadence to roll up.
Same metric-name normalization, numeric coercion, and worker-group stamping as the event feed, scoped to records that actually carry _metric.
Batch rename of clean-identifier fields shared by both branches (metric-side dimensions and the health object's status/startTime).
Stamp event.dataset (hyphen-free per ECS data-stream naming).
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
